name: Purifying Rain
body:
Purifying Rain

School conjuration (creation) [water]; Level cleric/oracle 3, druid 3, hunter 3, paladin 3, shaman 3, witch 3

CASTING

Casting Time 1 round
Components V, S, M (an aquamarine worth 50 gp)

EFFECT

Range long (400 ft. + 40 ft./level)
Area cylinder (40-ft. radius, 20 ft. high)
Duration 1 round/level (see text)
Saving Throw none (harmless); Spell Resistance yes (harmless, object)

You conjure a shower of pure water, cleansing whatever it touches. This functions as heavy rain. The area where the rain falls is affected as though by purify food and drink. Any exposed non-magical poison, disease or similar contamination affecting a surface is neutralized, and creatures within the area gain a +4 bonus on saving throws and skill checks to resist or treat such effects (magical or otherwise) for as long as they remain in the rain and 1 hour thereafter. The area is cleansed of grime, blood and similar filth within 1 round. Effects dependent on the presence of blood or filth, such as a grease or charnel house spell, can be removed, dispelled or suppressed with a successful caster level check as though using dispel magic.

Effects and abilities that modify the impact of weather apply as normal.

Purifying rain counters and dispels tainted sleet.
